description: She wears an opaque muted brick-red floor-length gown with a fitted low square bodice and elbow-length sleeves, bordered by narrow gold-and-dark geometric woven trim. A cream underdress shows at the neckline, wrists and lower central skirt opening above brown closed shoes. A matching red shoulder wrap lined in cream drapes loosely over both forearms with decorated edges. A brown leather-looking belt carries several circular metal ornaments and a hanging end. Small earrings and a round pendant add restrained jewelry. Fabric appears dense and wool-like over linen-like pale layers; exact fibers are uncertain.
